title: Frontend Digest — 25 Jul 2026
excerpt: 5 link hari ini: React 19, CSS nesting, Turbopack, TypeScript 5.7, Web Animation.

items.title: React 19 Features
items.insight: React 19 finally production-ready dengan compiler, actions, dan hooks baru yang mengurangi boilerplate.

items.title: CSS Nesting is Here to Stay
items.insight: CSS Nesting sudah didukung semua browser modern. Saatnya migrasi dari Sass.

items.title: Turbopack in Production
items.insight: Turbopack now default di Next.js 15. Build 10x lebih cepat dari webpack.

items.title: TypeScript 5.7: Better Error Messages
items.insight: Error messages jadi jauh lebih readable. Underrated quality-of-life improvement.

items.title: The State of Web Animation in 2026
items.insight: View Transitions API + WAAPI + CSS scroll-driven animations sudah mature untuk production.
